notes: This phase adds the world-overview density field promised by semantic LOD without changing Person or historical data.
Each screen cell counts unique ATLAS Person identities whose primary Activity placement crosses that time cell; duplicate Activities/segments for the same Person do not inflate the count.
A long-lived Person may contribute to multiple vertical time cells because the field represents activity through time rather than one arbitrary biography point.
Raw counts stay available for inspection while log normalization is used only for visual intensity scaling.
The legend explicitly states that this is ATLAS dataset density, not historical population, geopolitical power, or editorial importance.
Production v1 remains authoritative until the later v2 cutover.
